name: participation-brief
title: Supplier participation evidence brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM programmes ORDER BY name

sections.title: Evidence coverage
sections.note: Internal paid-spend evidence share only. Not a statutory DBE, MBE or WBE credit determination.

sections.title: Evidence exceptions
sections.sql: SELECT supplier,external_id,paid_date,has_dated_evidence,in_period FROM spend_evidence WHERE programme_id=$1 AND (NOT in_period OR NOT has_dated_evidence)

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due,state,closure_evidence FROM actions WHERE programme_id=$1 ORDER BY due

name: supplier-evidence
title: Supplier evidence review
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM suppliers ORDER BY name

sections.title: Certificates recorded
sections.sql: SELECT scheme,issuer,valid_from,valid_to,reviewed_by,evidence_ref FROM certificates WHERE supplier_id=$1 ORDER BY valid_to
sections.note: Evidence is supplied and reviewed by the operator. No external certification is granted or verified by this system.
